source_gap_claims.behavior: Network-capable Skill declarations specify allowed schemes and targets, and identify owners for redirects, DNS resolution, private/loopback/metadata blocking, controlled internal exceptions, and timeouts.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require these network policy fields or their owning authorities.
source_gap_claims.subject: Network capability declarations

source_gap_claims.behavior: Declaration validation rejects arbitrary URL execution, HTTP downgrade, and missing redirect or address policy for network capabilities.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers these network-specific declaration failure conditions.
source_gap_claims.subject: Network capability validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Package A validation performs no DNS resolution, URL request, or network-tool installation.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not establish this network non-execution boundary.
source_gap_claims.subject: Package A network boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Inventory mode reports a pre-standard fixture as legacy, while strict mode rejects it.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not define legacy reporting or strict rejection for pre-standard fixtures.
source_gap_claims.subject: Inventory and strict migration modes

source_gap_claims.behavior: A missing quality sidecar is never silently reported as pass.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not cover absent quality-sidecar handling.
source_gap_claims.subject: Quality sidecar absence

source_gap_claims.behavior: A migrated fixture validates while retaining its owner-specific authority and lifecycle fields.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires migration validation to preserve these owner-specific fields.
source_gap_claims.subject: Migrated fixture preservation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Migration verification compares explicit before-and-after owner and authorizes fields and fails on any drift.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require this migration oracle or drift detection.
source_gap_claims.subject: Migration fixture oracle

source_gap_claims.behavior: Migration checking is limited to fixture/composition verification and does not claim that static validation infers arbitrary Skill semantics.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not state this semantic-claim boundary.
source_gap_claims.subject: Migration verification scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator never rewrites the inspected package during migration or validation.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation prohibits mutation of the inspected package.
source_gap_claims.subject: Validator mutation boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: The actual published policy and both quality schemas validate with a small Package A reference package located under the fixture tree.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations cover individual contract validation but do not require this end-to-end reference-package validation of the actual policy and both schemas.
source_gap_claims.subject: Reference package validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: The reference-package test exercises the published CLI rather than a test-local lookalike.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires the reference fixture to invoke the published CLI or excludes a lookalike implementation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Published CLI integration

source_gap_claims.behavior: Terminal acceptance is blocked by inconsistent policy/schema versions, an unused policy, a schema-invalid result, a dangling standard link, or an invalid reference package.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not define these Package A terminal acceptance blockers as a combined verification gate.
source_gap_claims.subject: Reference-package terminal gate

source_gap_claims.behavior: The reference package is not treated as an installed Skill or as a new workflow entry.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation preserves this fixture classification boundary.
source_gap_claims.subject: Reference package scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: One repository-owned pytest terminal selection executes all Package A unit, boundary, negative, and CLI integration cases with independent expected results and explicit case-to-assertion mappings.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require one repository-owned terminal selection or these complete case/assertion mappings.
source_gap_claims.subject: Package A terminal test selection

source_gap_claims.behavior: Required terminal cases that are missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, zero-case, or affected by a harness error cannot produce a passing acceptance result.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation defines these test-harness completeness and status gates.
source_gap_claims.subject: Terminal test completeness

source_gap_claims.behavior: A negative fixture rejected as expected counts as a passing test case rather than failing the overall suite.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not specify this negative-test result interpretation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Negative test outcome semantics
